subject: POC kickoff & trial plan — Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Parker <sam.parker@acme.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff & trial plan — Acme Industries

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps to get the POC running: 

Summary / Success criteria (as discussed)
- Evaluate retrieval-augmented generation for customer support KB: responses under 600ms median latency and >= 85% accuracy on our eval prompt set.
- Embeddings-based semantic search recall >= 90% on labeled sample.
- Integration: demo of workflows calling Redwood via API from your sandbox app.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline
- Kickoff call (internal + your engineering): week of Nov 30 (30 mins) — align on sandbox credentials, test dataset, and success criteria.
- Trial window: Dec 1 — Dec 15 (2 weeks) with weekly check-ins (30 mins) on Thursdays.
- Final readout: Dec 18 — demo + results + next-step recommendation.

Owners
- Redwood SE owner: Connor O'Brien (cc'd) — will manage integrations and weekly check-ins.
- Redwood AM: Alex Martinez — pricing/contract follow-up.
- Acme internal owner: Sam Parker — product owner for evaluation and success sign-off.

Attachments: Acme_POC_TrialPlan_v1.pdf (trial milestones, data checklist, test prompts)

Next steps
1) Confirm kickoff window that works for your engineering team.
2) Share sandbox credentials and any IP/PII exclusions for the test dataset.
3) Loop in procurement/legal if you anticipate contract or security questions early.

Happy to adjust timeline if you need more runway.
\Cheers,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0134
[attachment: Acme_POC_TrialPlan_v1.pdf]

From: Sam Parker <sam.parker@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:22 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & trial plan — Acme Industries

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This matches what we discussed; a couple of small edits to the success criteria before we lock in:
- Latency target: 600ms median is fine, but can we add P95 < 1.5s as a constraint for our UX?
- For the embedding recall, we'll validate on our labeled set (we'll share it) but would like an initial baseline run in the first 48hrs.

Kickoff availability: our eng lead is available Thu Dec 2 at 10:00am PT for a 30-minute kickoff. Does that work for your team?

Procurement & legal: looping in Priya Rao (cc) — she can handle contract intake and will share PO/contract timeline. If legal needs an SOW, please send a draft.

Also please confirm whether Redwood will provision API keys with scoped access for the sandbox and whether we should upload the test dataset to a shared S3 bucket or provide it via secure drive link.

Onboarding note: please include Connor as the SE owner in calendar invites.

—Sam
Sam Parker
Product Manager | Acme Industries
sam.parker@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Parker <sam.parker@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & trial plan — Acme Industries

Sam —

Dec 2 at 10:00am PT works for us. I scheduled the kickoff for Thu, Dec 2, 10:00am PT and sent a calendar invite to you, Priya, and your engineering lead. Connor will lead the technical portion.

Updated success criteria per your note:
- Median latency <= 600ms, P95 < 1.5s
- Embeddings recall >= 90% on your labeled set — Redwood will run an initial baseline within 48hrs of dataset receipt.

What Redwood will provide before kickoff
- Scoped API key and sandbox project credentials (expires 30 days)
- Trial plan doc (attached) and test prompt set
- Access instructions for our sample Docker image for local validation

Weekly cadence and final readout
- Weekly check-ins: Thursdays 10:00am PT during trial (Dec 3, 10) — 30 mins, technical + results review.
- Final readout: Fri Dec 18, 2:00pm PT — 45 mins. We'll present metrics, qualitative examples, and recommended next steps.

Connor — can you own the weekly check-ins and baseline run? Please confirm availability for the Thursday cadence.

Thanks — I'll also send a draft SOW for procurement to review.
\Best,
Marissa
[attachment: Redwood_POC_SOW_draft.docx]

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>

Cc: legal@acme.com, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & trial plan — Acme Industries

Thanks for the invite and the materials. Procurement/legal here — copied our contracts inbox (legal@acme.com). A few notes from our side:

- Please send the draft SOW and any standard DPA/TOU we should review.
- We'll need a high-level data handling summary (how Redwood stores the test dataset, retention schedule, and whether logs are accessible to Redwood ops) before issuing a PO.
- For sandbox credentials: prefer a scoped API key + temporary S3 share for the dataset. Include instructions for rotating keys.

We anticipate a 2-week review on contracts once we receive the SOW and DPA. If everything looks standard we can have PO ready by Dec 10.

Alex — please loop in pricing or discount approvals if there are demo credits or trial concessions.

Looking forward to the kickoff on Dec 2.
\Best,
Priya Rao
Procurement | Acme Industries
priya.rao@acme.com
